description: This PHP file contains utility functions related to External OAuth Providers within a SuiteCRM module. It includes functions to generate HTML select elements for OAuth provider connectors and to retrieve redirect URIs, mainly used in different views such as DetailView, EditView, etc.

methods.name: getExternalOAuthProviderConnectors
methods.description: Generates HTML select element for OAuth provider connectors or returns the connector value depending on the view context.

methods.name: getExternalOAuthProviderRedirectURI
methods.description: Returns the redirect URI for the external OAuth provider focus object.
